name: VisibilityToggle
summary: The eye (and padlock) toggle (Q125): the established, universal pattern for showing or hiding one thing in a list (a layer, a fill, a stroke, an effect, a page colour) and for locking it. A pressed icon button: its icon is the state (eye or eye with a slash; closed or open padlock), so it carries no fill when on. Unlike other toggle buttons it needs no written reason where it's used: it is the library's named pattern for these two meanings. For any other binary setting use Switch.
a11y: A `button` with `aria-pressed` (true when shown or locked) and a name that never changes with the state ("Show Logo", "Lock Logo"), so the pressed state is what's announced; the label also shows as its tooltip.

props.name: name
props.description: What it acts on, in the words a person sees: "Logo", "fill 1". Named "Show {name}" or "Lock {name}".

props.name: kind
props.description: `visibility` (default): an eye that closes when hidden; `lock`: a padlock that opens when unlocked.

props.name: size
props.description: The Button size scale; `xs` in a list row or a property row.

props.name: verb
props.description: The words before the name, for another language: "Show" or "Lock" by default.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Leave the tooltip off where the row already says what it is.
